entries.subject: DAMIT 1144: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1144.txt. Model 1144, version 2016-01-04, pole (233°, 50°), period 18.11914 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Original shape table
entries.finding: [Original shape table](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/4173/shape.txt) — counted XYZ vertices and one-based triangle indices.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "33.25 km (size-calibrated model)" (hanus-2018-thermophysical-models) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 81, DAMIT model 1144 diameter 69 ± 2 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 1144 fitted to 7 occultations); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
